info.name: Makoto
info.description: Sound cartridge with a Yamaha YM2608 (OPNA) at 8 MHz on I/O ports $14-$17: FM 6 channels, SSG 3 channels, rhythm 6 sounds and ADPCM 1 channel with 256 kB sample RAM. The rhythm part needs the YM2608 rhythm ROM (8 kB, not included) in the systemroms directory; without it the rhythm part is silent.
